typical_rto_causes: Buyer changed mind — low-commitment impulse purchase
Address or serviceability issues in the delivery pincode
Light.cod_notes: Light, low-value items see the highest COD-refusal rate of any weight class — prepaid discounts are usually worth testing to offset this.
Light.carrier_notes: Fits the standard courier network without special handling.

typical_rto_causes: Delivery attempt failures in tier-2/tier-3 pincodes
Medium.cod_notes: Moderate COD-refusal rate — consider a prepaid-only policy for higher-value medium-weight items specifically.
Medium.carrier_notes: Standard courier network; confirm weight-based freight slabs don't quietly erode margin at this weight class.

typical_rto_causes: Buyer unavailable for a bulky/scheduled delivery
Damage in transit — handling risk rises with size and weight
Heavy.cod_notes: Heavy items should strongly prefer prepaid — reverse-logistics cost for a refused COD heavy item is disproportionately high.
Heavy.carrier_notes: May require specialized or surface logistics — confirm the courier partner actually services heavy-item categories before trusting a shipping-cost estimate.
